descriptionHtml:
Lenovo Legion 5 Pro 16IRX10 Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i7-14650HX - RTX 5050 8GB - 240Hz Display - Windows 11 Edition

Step up to pro-tier competitive performance with the Lenovo Legion 5 Pro 16IRX10, expertly provided by Turbo Computer Egypt. Driven by the formidable 14th generation Intel Core i7-14650HX processor architecture and fully accelerated by the next-generation NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 8GB dedicated graphics engine, this machine delivers jaw-dropping frame rates for modern AAA titles. It comes fully licensed with pre-installed Windows 11 Home software to provide peak operational efficiency. The true crown jewel is its 16.0-inch WQXGA premium gaming display, boasting an ultra-fluid 240Hz refresh rate matrix for buttery-smooth panning and lightning-fast flick shots. Kept ice-cold via the legendary Legion Coldfront thermal dynamics and wrapped inside a sleek Onyx Grey precision chassis, this premium powerhouse is officially backed by a 2-year authorized agent warranty across Egypt.
